name: ai-branches

frames.best_why: Shows the forked conversation after an edit, with four branches counted and the new reply fully written.

tagline: Editing a sent message forks a new chat branch, with a mini tree to jump.
summary: A compact chat window where each sent message can be edited, and an edit grows a new branch. Arrows page through versions, a small tree on the right maps every branch, and clicking a node switches the conversation.
appearance: A rounded dark chat card titled Trip planning with a branch count at the top right. Bubbles alternate: right-aligned grey user messages with tiny edit and version arrows, left-aligned assistant paragraphs. A narrow rail of connected dots runs down the right edge.
behaviour: Hovering a message lights it and reveals its controls; the pencil opens an inline editor, and sending adds a forked reply that types itself in. Version arrows slide between siblings, and the rail's nodes preview and switch branches.
demo_content: Trip planning chat about three days in Lisbon and Porto, with edits like "Make day 3 less touristy".
search_phrases: compare different replies to same prompt
edit prompt and keep both responses
use_when: People may want to rewrite a prompt and keep both answers side by side for comparison.
avoid_when: The tiny version arrows and narrow tree rail demand a fine pointer, and you must supply the flat message history.
customise: Pass a flat messages array with ids and parents, a reply function that may stream, an onChange callback and a title; the tree layout and styling stay fixed.
weight_why: A short message list and a small SVG tree, animated only when something changes.

a11y.note: Controls are labelled and focus is moved for you, but the tree nodes are tiny targets and the streaming caret is hidden from screen readers.

props.name: reply
props.type: (prompt: string, history: BranchMessage[], signal: AbortSignal) => BranchReply

issues: Message edit buttons stay invisible until hover or keyboard focus.
polish_why: Tidy branching model and clear version controls; tiny targets and a cramped tree rail.
title: AI Branches
